rationale.conceptual: The method is a standard DFT workflow using an established code (Quantum ESPRESSO) and a commonly used functional (PBE-GGA). No new algorithms need to be implemented; the paper simply applies existing tools to a specific material system. Setting up the correct supercells, k‑point grids, and spin arrangements requires care but is a textbook application of the method.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves generating six slab models, running a bulk Ni validation, performing 12 DFT relaxations (six configurations × two spin couplings), extracting DOS for three configurations, and compiling results. This spans 7 declared steps with dependencies; orchestrating multiple DFT runs, handling convergence, and post‑processing constitutes a moderate multi‑stage workflow.
